g.text: The engine decides and computes · the LLM translates and explains · the manager validates
[1] Optimisation engine - the only source of decisions and numbers
LLM layer - translates and explains, never decides
[5] Memory & learning - proposes, never applies silently
new incident · team on site · repair done · team late / unavailable · shift end
dotted arrow = proposal to the manager, or internal call
